sections.heading: Tom Hardy — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Tom Hardy was born on 15 September 1977 in Hammersmith, and holds British nationality. He was given the name Edward Thomas Hardy at birth and is publicly known as Tom Hardy.
Public records name his father, Chips Hardy.
He studied at Tower House School, Richmond Adult Community College, Drama Centre London and Reed's School.
He is recorded as speaking British English.

paras: Tom Hardy works primarily as a screenwriter, stage actor, film actor, model, executive producer and film producer.
